files.strategy_reasoning: The guideline explicitly requires feature-level matching with numeric tolerances and equal feature counts. Approximate comparison supports record alignment and toleranced values, making it appropriate for this TSV.

align_plan.reasoning: Both tables contain features as rows, so no transpose is needed. Select the five identically named reference columns in the required TSV order and exclude candidate metadata. No shared stable identifier exists: feature_id is absent from the reference, charge is not unique, and measured continuous values must not be exact keys. Sort both tables by rt and align positionally to satisfy the explicit retention-time ordering requirement. Require 256 features and validate paired rt within 10 seconds, mz within 0.01, and intensity relative absolute error within 10%. Sorting alone cannot guarantee correct feature correspondence when nearby peaks change order; tolerance-based one-to-one matching would be needed to resolve such cases.

A fixed RAE tolerance cannot express this absolute bound across varying reference values. column_configs.name: mz
column_configs.reasoning: Mass-to-charge ratio is critical. The required check is abs(candidate - reference) <= 0.01. A fixed RAE tolerance cannot express this absolute bound across varying reference values. Use a separate absolute-error check; this unthresholded RAE configuration provides supplementary comparison only.

column_configs.name: intensity
column_configs.reasoning: Intensity is critical and requires abs(candidate - reference) / abs(reference) <= 0.10. This relative tolerance accommodates the large variation in intensity scales. For zero reference intensity, require candidate intensity to be zero.

comparison_plan.overall_reasoning: Compare rt, mz, and intensity because these define feature acceptance in the evaluation guideline. All are float64 measurements, so cell-level numerical errors are appropriate; correlations cannot establish individual feature compliance. Exclude charge and quality because no value-matching requirements are specified for them, and exclude candidate-only metadata. Independently verify 256 features, the required TSV header columns, and ascending rt order before index-based comparison. Every feature must pass all three bounds; an average match fraction below 1 fails. The schema cannot fully encode the absolute rt and mz tolerances, so their separate absolute-error checks are mandatory. Equivalently, an evaluator supporting per-row RAE thresholds could use 10/abs(reference_rt) and 0.01/abs(reference_mz) for nonzero reference values. No categorical parsing or overlap thresholds apply.
